trap.label: sem be
trap.wrong: The plot can summarize in one line.
trap.right: The plot can be summarized in one line.
trap.why: Em português “pode resumir-se” usa a voz passiva pronominal. Em inglês, modal + passiva exige be + particípio.

fix.wrong: The debut novel must be wrote again.
fix.right: The debut novel must be written again.

fix.wrong: The author is believed have lost it.
fix.right: The author is believed to have lost it.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Someone ought to have cut some twists.”
rewrite.answer: Some twists ought to have been cut.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com is said: “People say the sequel is late.”
rewrite.answer: The sequel is said to be late.
